function setLanguage(l){if(!['en','es'].includes(l)||l===lang)return;saveBookPosition();lang=l;try{localStorage.setItem('katabasis-language',lang)}catch{}translateUI();renderReading();if(page==='catalog')renderCatalog();if(page==='packages')renderPackages();if(page==='favorites')renderFavorites();if(page==='workshop')renderWorkshop();if(active!==null)renderBook();if($('#daily').open)renderDaily();if($('#about').open)renderAbout();if($('#art-dialog').open)renderArtDetail()}
function highlight(key){document.querySelectorAll('#book .lit').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('lit'));litKey=key;if(key)document.querySelectorAll('#book .segment').forEach(s=>{if(s.dataset.key===key)s.classList.add('lit')})}
function renderBook(){const w=works[active],isSame=w.lang===lang;litKey=null;let n=0;const rows=w.segments.map((r,i)=>{const cells=[lang,'original'].map(side=>`<div class="parallel-cell" lang="${side==='original'?w.lang:lang}" dir="${side==='original'&&w.lang==='he'?'rtl':'ltr'}">${r.map((s,j)=>`<span class="segment" data-key="${i}-${j}" tabindex="${n++===0?'0':'-1'}">${esc(s[side])}</span>`).join('')}</div>`);return `<div class="parallel-row">${cells.join('')}</div>`}).join('');$('#book-content').innerHTML=`<div class="book-title"><h2 id="book-title">${esc(titleOf(w))}</h2><p>${esc(w.author)} · ${esc(scopeOf(w))}</p>${favoriteButton('reading',w.id)}</div>${journeyPanel(w)}<div class="book-headings"><div>${languages[lang]} · ${isSame?ui[lang].original:(lang==='es'?'Traducción':'Translation')}</div><div>${esc(languageOf(w))} · ${ui[lang].original}</div></div><div class="parallel ${w.kind==='Poem'?'poem':w.kind==='Theatre'?'prose theatre':'prose'}">${rows}</div>${journeyEnd(w)}<div class="book-endnote"><p>${esc(lang==='es'?(w.note_es||w.note):w.note)}</p><p>${isSame?ui[lang].same:ui[lang].working}. ${lang==='es'?'La alineación relaciona palabras, frases u oraciones por significado; algunos pasajes se agrupan por párrafos.':'Alignment links words, phrases or sentences by meaning; some passages are grouped by paragraph.'}</p><a href="${esc(w.source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${ui[lang].source}</a>${w.translation_reference?` · <a href="${esc(w.translation_reference)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Versión de Budge (1922) ↗':'Budge’s version (1922) ↗'}</a>`:''}${w.context_source?` · <a href="${esc(w.context_source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Contexto y transmisión ↗':'Context and transmission ↗'}</a>`:''}${w.source_edition?`<p class="source-edition">${esc(w.source_edition)}</p>`:''}</div>`;$('#book-content').scrollTop=bookPositions.get(w.id)||0;const p=historyPosition;$('#previous').disabled=p<=0;$('#next').disabled=false;$('#previous').hidden=page!=='anthology'||!!w.journey_id;$('#next').hidden=page!=='anthology'||!!w.journey_id}
function openBook(id){const i=works.findIndex(w=>w.id===id&&isEnabled(w));if(i<0)return;saveBookPosition();active=i;renderBook();if(!$('#book').open)$('#book').showModal();document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeDialog(id){if(id==='book')saveBookPosition();$('#'+id).close();if(!document.querySelector('dialog[open]'))document.body.style.overflow='';if(id==='book')active=null}
function renderAbout(){if(lang==='es'){renderAboutSpanish();appendVisualSources();appendEditorialPolicy();return}const latest=Math.max(...works.map(w=>w.died||0));$('#about-body').innerHTML=`<p>Katabasis shows one reading at a time, drawing the next only when you advance: complete poems and short fiction, plus passages identified by book, chapter, or verse. This edition contains <strong>${activeWorks().length} active readings</strong>; it is a curated beginning, not an exhaustive database.</p><h3>What belongs here?</h3><p>The requested collection rule is: a Christian author; an author born in a historically majority-Christian country or society; or a text from ancient Greece, ancient Israel, or ancient Rome. It is a collection rule, not a claim about an author’s beliefs. Non-Christian and dissenting writers are included under the birthplace rule.</p><h3>Originals and translations</h3><p>Each reading links to its source. Original works are selected for public-domain status in the United States and jurisdictions using life plus 70 or 80 years, including Colombia. The latest author death in this edition is ${latest}. Publication dates and special national provisions can differ; this is not a claim of identical rights worldwide.</p><p>The English and Spanish versions marked <em>New AI working translation</em> were made for this edition. The Ethiopian readings use Budge’s public-domain 1922 English translation as an intermediary; their notes identify this route. The other new versions follow the displayed original. They are reading aids, not established literary translations or approved liturgical texts. They may lose nuance. When the selected language is the original, you see the original on both pages.</p><p>Original spelling and punctuation may be lightly normalized. Each highlighted unit is an editorial alignment of a word, phrase or sentence, not an automatically inferred one-to-one equivalence. Hover, tap, or use the arrow keys inside the book.</p><h3>Today’s readings</h3><p>The daily-reading link uses your device’s date and opens the USCCB’s Roman Catholic calendar in a new tab. The official modern lectionary wording is copyrighted and is not copied here. A separately dated Scripture selection is included in the anthology in new working translations. Local solemnities and other Catholic rites may use different readings.</p><h3>Coverage still to grow</h3><p>Greek and Roman antiquity, the Bible, Europe, the Americas, Australia, and the Philippines are represented. Optional packages add modern Greece, medieval Ethiopian Christian literature in Geʽez, and Christian voices from India, Japan and Chinese literature. Do not treat this edition as complete coverage of Christendom.</p><h3>Sources for longer visits</h3><ul><li><a href="https://www.gutenberg.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Project Gutenberg</a></li><li><a href="https://wikisource.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Wikisource, in many languages</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cervantesvirtual.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes</a></li></ul><p>All anthology text is built into this HTML and can be read offline. Source libraries and daily readings require an internet connection.</p>`;appendVisualSources();appendEditorialPolicy()}
function renderDaily(){const now=new Date(),code=String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')+String(now.getFullYear()).slice(-2);const date=now.toLocaleDateString(lang==='es'?'es-CO':'en-US',{weekday:'long',month:'long',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'});$('#daily-body').innerHTML=`<p class="daily-date">${esc(date)}</p><a class="book-btn daily-link" href="https://bible.usccb.org/bible/readings/${code}.cfm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Lecturas oficiales de hoy ↗':'Read today’s official readings ↗'}</a><p>${lang==='es'?'Abre el calendario católico romano de la USCCB. Allí puedes elegir «En Español».':'Opens the USCCB Roman Catholic calendar. Spanish is available through “En Español” on that page.'}</p><p class="notice">${lang==='es'?'Las lecturas diarias se abren en la fuente oficial; no se actualizan dentro de este archivo.':'Daily readings open at the official source; they are not synchronized inside this file.'}</p><div class="reading-list"><p class="tiny-title">${lang==='es'?'Selección incluida · 11 de septiembre de 2026':'Included selection · September 11, 2026'}</p><p>1 Corinthians 9:16–19, 22b–27<br>Psalm 84:3, 4, 5–6, 12<br>John 17:17b, 17a<br>Luke 6:39–42</p><button data-daily-book="luke-blind">${lang==='es'?'Leer el Evangelio: la astilla y la viga →':'Read the Gospel: the splinter and the beam →'}<small>Luke 6:39–42 · ${ui[lang].working}</small></button><p><a href="https://bible.usccb.org/bible/readings/091126.cfm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Fuente de esta fecha ↗':'Source for this date ↗'}</a></p></div>`}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const l=e.target.closest('[data-lang]');if(l)setLanguage(l.dataset.lang);const b=e.target.closest('[data-book]');if(b)openBook(b.dataset.book);const d=e.target.closest('[data-daily-book]');if(d){closeDialog('daily');openBook(d.dataset.dailyBook)}const c=e.target.closest('[data-close]');if(c)closeDialog(c.dataset.close);const s=e.target.closest('#book .segment');if(s){highlight(litKey===s.dataset.key?null:s.dataset.key);document.querySelectorAll('#book .segment[tabindex="0"]').forEach(x=>x.tabIndex=-1);s.tabIndex=0;s.focus({preventScroll:true})}});
$('#book-content').addEventListener('mouseover',e=>{const s=e.target.closest('.segment');if(s)highlight(s.dataset.key)});
$('#book-content').addEventListener('mouseout',e=>{if(e.target.closest('.segment')&&!(e.relatedTarget instanceof Element && e.relatedTarget.closest('.segment'))&&e.pointerType!=='touch')highlight(null)});
$('#book-content').addEventListener('focusin',e=>{if(e.target.matches('.segment'))highlight(e.target.dataset.key)});
$('#book-content').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!e.target.matches('.segment'))return;const keys=['ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','ArrowDown','ArrowUp'];if(!keys.includes(e.key))return;e.preventDefault();const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('#book .segment')],i=all.indexOf(e.target),direction=['ArrowRight','ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)?1:-1;const next=all[Math.max(0,Math.min(all.length-1,i+direction))];e.target.tabIndex=-1;next.tabIndex=0;next.focus()});
$('#previous').onclick=()=>discover(-1);$('#next').onclick=()=>discover(1);$('#discover-prev').onclick=()=>discover(-1);$('#discover-next').onclick=()=>discover(1);
document.querySelectorAll('dialog').forEach(d=>{d.addEventListener('close',()=>{if(!document.querySelector('dialog[open]'))document.body.style.overflow='';if(d.id==='book'){saveBookPosition();active=null}});d.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===d){const r=d.getBoundingClientRect();if(e.clientX<r.left||e.clientX>r.right||e.clientY<r.top||e.clientY>r.bottom)closeDialog(d.id)}})});
$('#daily-open').onclick=()=>{renderDaily();$('#daily').showModal()};$('#about-open').onclick=()=>{renderAbout();$('#about').showModal()};$('#home').onclick=()=>switchPage('anthology');$('.rail .brand').onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();switchPage('anthology')};

document.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(page!=='anthology'||document.querySelector('dialog[open]')||Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)||e.ctrlKey)return;e.preventDefault();clearTimeout(wheelTimer);wheelTimer=setTimeout(()=>{wheelTotal=0;wheelUsed=false},240);if(wheelUsed)return;wheelTotal+=e.deltaY*(e.deltaMode===1?18:e.deltaMode===2?400:1);if(Math.abs(wheelTotal)>65){wheelUsed=true;discover(wheelTotal>0?1:-1)}},{passive:false});
$('.feed-wrap').addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(e.touches.length!==1||(e.target.closest('button,a')&&!e.target.closest('[data-art]')))return;touchStart={x:e.touches[0].clientX,y:e.touches[0].clientY}},{passive:true});
$('.feed-wrap').addEventListener('touchend',e=>{if(!touchStart||document.querySelector('dialog[open]'))return;const t=e.changedTouches[0],dy=touchStart.y-t.clientY,dx=touchStart.x-t.clientX;touchStart=null;if(Math.abs(dy)>65&&Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx)*1.3&&(!window.getSelection||!window.getSelection().toString())){suppressArtClickUntil=Date.now()+400;discover(dy>0?1:-1)}},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(page!=='anthology'||document.querySelector('dialog[open]')||e.target.closest('button,a,input,select,textarea')||e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey||e.altKey||e.repeat)return;if(['ArrowDown','PageDown',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();discover(1)}else if(['ArrowUp','PageUp'].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();discover(-1)}});
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>requestAnimationFrame(fitPreview));if('ResizeObserver' in window)new ResizeObserver(fitPreview).observe($('#feed'));
translateUI();const opening=works.findIndex(w=>w.id==='long-happened');if(opening>=0){current=opening;seen.add(current);history.push({type:'reading',index:current});historyPosition=0;readingsSincePainting=1;renderReading()}else discover();

function renderAboutSpanish(){$('#about-body').innerHTML=`<p><strong>Katabasis</strong> reúne ${activeWorks().length} lecturas activas: poemas, cuentos completos y capítulos. Solo muestra una lectura a la vez. La siguiente se elige cuando avanzas; puedes volver a las que ya viste.</p><h3>La colección</h3><p>El criterio incluye autores cristianos; autores nacidos en sociedades históricamente de mayoría cristiana; y textos de la Grecia, el Israel o la Roma antiguos. No presupone las creencias personales de cada autor.</p><h3>Originales y traducciones</h3><p>Cada lectura identifica su fuente y si se trata de una obra completa o un fragmento. Los originales elegidos son de dominio público en Estados Unidos y en países con plazos generales de vida más 70 u 80 años, como Colombia; las reglas especiales pueden variar.</p><p>Las traducciones marcadas como generadas por IA se hicieron para esta edición. Las lecturas etíopes emplean como intermediaria la traducción inglesa de Budge de 1922, de dominio público; sus notas lo indican. Las demás versiones nuevas siguen el original mostrado. Son ayudas de lectura, no traducciones literarias consagradas ni versiones litúrgicas aprobadas. Cuando eliges la lengua original, ambas páginas muestran el mismo texto.</p><p>Los segmentos relacionan palabras, frases u oraciones por su significado. Algunos pasajes se agrupan por párrafos. Puedes señalarlos con el cursor, tocarlos o recorrerlos con las flechas del teclado. La ortografía y la puntuación pueden estar ligeramente normalizadas.</p><h3>Lecturas católicas</h3><p>El enlace diario abre la página oficial de la USCCB según la fecha de tu dispositivo. Su traducción moderna no está copiada aquí. Los calendarios locales y otros ritos pueden tener lecturas distintas.</p><h3>Una colección en crecimiento</h3><p>Aún no es una base exhaustiva. Los paquetes amplían la colección con Grecia moderna, literatura cristiana etíope en geʽez y voces cristianas de India, Japón y la literatura china. Unas cuatro lecturas por paquete es la referencia; la selección puede ser menor para mantener la calidad.</p><p>Toda la antología se puede leer sin conexión. Las fuentes externas y las lecturas diarias requieren internet.</p><p><a href="https://www.gutenberg.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Project Gutenberg</a> · <a href="https://wikisource.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Wikisource</a> · <a href="https://www.cervantesvirtual.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Biblioteca Cervantes</a></p>`}

function regionName(g){return g[lang]||g.en}
function regionCount(id){return activeWorks().filter(w=>w.region===id).length}
function readingCount(n){return `${n} ${lang==='es'?(n===1?'lectura':'lecturas'):(n===1?'reading':'readings')}`}
function authorCount(n){return `${n} ${lang==='es'?(n===1?'autor':'autores'):(n===1?'author':'authors')}`}
function countryColor(n){return n>=4?'#68462f':n>=2?'#a47b55':n===1?'#cbb08e':'#e6dbce'}
function regionButtons(groups){return groups.map(g=>`<button class="region-button" data-region="${esc(g.id)}" aria-controls="catalog-results" aria-pressed="${selectedRegion===g.id}"><span>${esc(regionName(g))}</span><b>${regionCount(g.id)}</b><span class="visually-hidden">${lang==='es'?'lecturas':'readings'}</span></button>`).join('')}
function renderCatalog(){
    const scroll=$('#catalog-view').scrollTop, groups=geography.groups.filter(g=>regionCount(g.id)>0), modern=groups.filter(g=>!g.historical).sort((a,b)=>regionName(a).localeCompare(regionName(b),lang)), ancient=groups.filter(g=>g.historical), authors=new Set(activeWorks().map(w=>w.author)).size;
    const paths=geography.countries.map(c=>{const n=regionCount(c.id),g=groups.find(g=>g.id===c.id)||c,label=`${regionName(g)} · ${readingCount(n)}`;return `<path class="country${n?' available':''}${selectedRegion===c.id?' selected':''}" d="${c.d}" fill-rule="evenodd" style="--country-color:${countryColor(n)}" ${n?`data-map-region="${c.id}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-pressed="${selectedRegion===c.id}" aria-label="${esc(label)}"`:''}><title>${esc(label)}</title></path>`}).join('');
    const markers=ancient.filter(g=>g.anchor).map(g=>`<g class="ancient-marker${selectedRegion===g.id?' selected':''}" transform="translate(${g.anchor.join(' ')})" data-map-region="${g.id}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-pressed="${selectedRegion===g.id}" aria-label="${esc(regionName(g))} · ${readingCount(regionCount(g.id))}"><title>${esc(regionName(g))} · ${readingCount(regionCount(g.id))}</title><circle r="5"/><text text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${regionCount(g.id)}</text></g>`).join('');
    $('#catalog-view').innerHTML=`<div class="catalog-inner"><div class="catalog-heading"><div><p class="tiny-title">${lang==='es'?'Tu colección activa':'Your active collection'}</p><h2 id="catalog-title" tabindex="-1">${lang==='es'?'Un atlas de lecturas':'An atlas of readings'}</h2><p>${lang==='es'?'Cada país, una puerta a sus voces. Elige un lugar para descubrir sus obras y autores.':'Every country opens onto its voices. Choose a place to discover its works and authors.'}</p></div><div class="catalog-stats"><div><strong>${activeWorks().length}</strong>${ui[lang].readings}</div><div><strong>${authors}</strong>${lang==='es'?'autores':'authors'}</div><div><strong>${modern.length}</strong>${lang==='es'?'países y territorios':'countries & territories'}</div></div></div><div class="atlas"><div class="atlas-top"><p>${lang==='es'?'Lecturas por país':'Readings by country'}</p><div class="map-views" role="group" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Vista del mapa':'Map view'}"><button data-map-view="world" aria-pressed="${mapView==='world'}">${lang==='es'?'Mundo':'World'}</button><button data-map-view="europe" aria-pressed="${mapView==='europe'}">${lang==='es'?'Europa':'Europe'}</button><button data-map-view="americas" aria-pressed="${mapView==='americas'}">${lang==='es'?'Américas':'Americas'}</button></div></div><svg class="world-map" id="world-map" viewBox="${mapBounds(mapView)}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="group" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Mapa interactivo de lecturas por país. También puedes usar la lista de países.':'Interactive map of readings by country. A country list is also available.'}">${paths}${markers}</svg><div class="map-caption"><p id="map-caption-text" role="status">${mapCaption()}</p><div class="map-key" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Leyenda: número de lecturas':'Legend: number of readings'}">${[0,1,2,4].map(n=>`<span><i style="--swatch:${countryColor(n)}"></i>${n===2?'2–3':n===4?'4+':n}</span>`).join('')}<span>${ui[lang].readings}</span></div></div></div><p class="ancient-map-key">${lang==='es'?'Los puntos sitúan tradiciones antiguas de forma orientativa; sus lecturas se cuentan aparte de los países actuales.':'Dots locate ancient traditions approximately; their readings are counted separately from modern countries.'}</p><div class="catalog-bottom"><div class="country-index"><div class="country-index-head"><h3>${lang==='es'?'Países y territorios':'Countries & territories'}</h3><button data-region="all" aria-controls="catalog-results" aria-pressed="${selectedRegion==='all'}">${lang==='es'?'Ver todo':'View all'}</button></div><div class="region-buttons">${regionButtons(modern)}</div><div class="ancient-index"><h4>${lang==='es'?'Tradiciones antiguas':'Ancient traditions'} · ${ancient.reduce((n,g)=>n+regionCount(g.id),0)}</h4><div class="region-buttons">${regionButtons(ancient)}</div></div><p class="geography-note">${lang==='es'?'Agrupación por país o tradición literaria de la colección; no siempre coincide con el lugar de nacimiento. Las tradiciones antiguas se cuentan aparte. Cada lectura cuenta una sola vez; las obras de arte no se incluyen en estos totales.':'Grouped by the collection’s country or literary tradition, which may differ from birthplace. Ancient traditions are counted separately. Each reading counts once; artworks are excluded from these totals.'}</p><p class="atlas-credit">${lang==='es'?'Cartografía':'Map data'}: <a href="https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Natural Earth · ${lang==='es'?'dominio público':'public domain'} ↗</a></p></div><section class="catalog-results" id="catalog-results" aria-labelledby="results-title"></section></div></div>`;
    renderCatalogResults();$('#catalog-view').scrollTop=scroll;
}
function mapBounds(view){return {world:'0 0 900 370',europe:'415 25 175 165',americas:'145 5 215 355'}[view]||'0 0 900 370'}
function mapCaption(id=selectedRegion){const g=geography.groups.find(g=>g.id===id);return g?`${esc(regionName(g))} · ${readingCount(regionCount(id))}`:(lang==='es'?'Señala o toca un país para ver sus lecturas.':'Hover or tap a country to see its readings.')}
function renderCatalogResults(){
    const selected=activeWorks().filter(w=>selectedRegion==='all'||w.region===selectedRegion), authors=[...new Set(selected.map(w=>w.author))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,lang)),g=geography.groups.find(g=>g.id===selectedRegion);
    $('#catalog-results').innerHTML=`<h3 id="results-title" tabindex="-1">${g?esc(regionName(g)):(lang==='es'?'Todas las obras':'All works')}</h3><p class="result-summary" role="status">${readingCount(selected.length)} · ${authorCount(authors.length)}</p>${authors.map(author=>{const list=selected.filter(w=>w.author===author);return `<div class="author-group"><h4>${esc(author)}</h4><p class="author-place">${esc(list[0].place)}</p>${list.map(w=>`<button class="catalog-work" data-book="${esc(w.id)}"><span><strong>${esc(titleOf(w))}</strong><small>${esc(kindOf(w))} · ${minutes(w)} · ${esc(languageOf(w))}<br>${esc(scopeOf(w))}</small></span><span class="open-arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>`).join('')}</div>`}).join('')}`;
}
function selectRegion(id){if(id!=='all'&&!geography.groups.some(g=>g.id===id&&regionCount(id)))return;selectedRegion=id;document.querySelectorAll('[data-region]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.region===id)));document.querySelectorAll('[data-map-region]').forEach(p=>{p.classList.toggle('selected',p.dataset.mapRegion===id);p.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(p.dataset.mapRegion===id))});$('#map-caption-text').innerHTML=mapCaption();renderCatalogResults();if(window.matchMedia('(max-width:730px)').matches)$('#results-title').focus({preventScroll:false})}
function setMapView(view){if(!['world','europe','americas'].includes(view))return;mapView=view;$('#world-map').setAttribute('viewBox',mapBounds(view));document.querySelectorAll('[data-map-view]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.mapView===view)))}
function switchPage(nextPage){if(!['anthology','catalog','packages','favorites','workshop'].includes(nextPage))return;page=nextPage;$('.feed-wrap').hidden=page!=='anthology';$('#catalog-view').hidden=page!=='catalog';$('#packages-view').hidden=page!=='packages';$('#favorites-view').hidden=page!=='favorites';$('#workshop-view').hidden=page!=='workshop';for(const [id,p] of [['home','anthology'],['catalog-open','catalog'],['packages-open','packages'],['favorites-open','favorites'],['workshop-open','workshop']]){$('#'+id).classList.toggle('active',page===p);$('#'+id).setAttribute('aria-current',page===p?'page':'false')}wheelTotal=0;wheelUsed=false;touchStart=null;translateUI();if(page==='catalog'){renderCatalog();$('#catalog-title').focus()}else if(page==='packages'){renderPackages();$('#packages-title').focus()}else if(page==='favorites'){renderFavorites();$('#favorites-title').focus()}else if(page==='workshop'){renderWorkshop();$('#workshop-title').focus()}else{renderReading();$('#reading-title').focus()}}
function paintField(p,key){return p[`${key}_${lang}`]||p[key]||''}
function paintingCard(p){return `<article class="reading painting-card" data-painting="${esc(p.id)}" aria-labelledby="reading-title"><div class="metadata"><span>${esc(paintField(p,'art_kind')||(lang==='es'?'Pintura':'Painting'))}</span><span>${lang==='es'?'Una pausa para mirar':'A moment to look'}</span></div><button class="painting-frame" data-art="${esc(p.id)}" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Ampliar':'Enlarge'}: ${esc(paintField(p,'title'))}"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${esc(paintField(p,'alt'))}" decoding="async" draggable="false"></button><div class="painting-caption"><h2 id="reading-title" tabindex="-1">${esc(paintField(p,'title'))}</h2><p class="author">${esc(paintField(p,'artist'))} · ${esc(paintField(p,'year'))} · ${esc((paintField(p,'artist_country')||paintField(p,'country')))}</p><div class="painting-meta"><p>${esc(p.museum)} · ${lang==='es'?'Dominio público':'Public domain'}</p><a href="${esc(p.source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Ver en el museo ↗':'View at the museum ↗'}</a></div>${favoriteButton('painting',p.id)}</div></article>`}
function drawPainting(){let pool=paintings.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>isEnabled(paintings[i])&&!paintingsSeen.has(i));if(!pool.length){paintingsSeen.clear();pool=paintings.map((_,i)=>i).filter(i=>isEnabled(paintings[i])&&(activePaintings().length===1||i!==lastPainting))}const i=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];paintingsSeen.add(i);lastPainting=i;return i}
function renderArtDetail(){const p=paintings[artDetailIndex];$('#art-detail').innerHTML=`<img src="${p.image}" alt="${esc(paintField(p,'alt'))}" decoding="async"><div class="art-detail-caption"><h2 id="art-detail-title">${esc(paintField(p,'title'))}</h2><p>${esc(paintField(p,'artist'))} · ${esc(paintField(p,'year'))} · ${esc(paintField(p,'medium'))}</p><p>${esc(p.museum)}</p>${paintField(p,'caption')?`<p class="art-context">${esc(paintField(p,'caption'))}</p>`:''}<a href="${esc(p.source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Ficha y fuente de la imagen':'Artwork record and image source'} ↗</a>${p.attribution?`<p class="art-rights">${esc(p.attribution)}${p.rights_policy_url?` · <a href="${esc(p.rights_policy_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Licencia':'Licence'} ↗</a>`:''}</p>`:''}${favoriteButton('painting',p.id)}</div>`}
function openArt(id){const i=paintings.findIndex(p=>p.id===id&&isEnabled(p));if(i<0)return;artDetailIndex=i;renderArtDetail();$('#art-dialog').showModal()}
function appendVisualSources(){const el=$('#about-body');el.innerHTML+=`<h3>${lang==='es'?'Arte y mapa':'Art and map'}</h3><p>${lang==='es'?`Cada cinco nuevas lecturas aparece una obra de arte. La selección incluye ${activePaintings().length} obras de arte de dominio público, con imágenes y fichas de museo. Volver a una lectura ya vista no altera el intervalo.`:`An artwork appears after every five new readings. The selection includes ${activePaintings().length} public-domain artworks with museum images and records. Returning through your reading history does not change this interval.`}</p><p>${lang==='es'?'El mapa y las pinturas están incluidos en el archivo y funcionan sin conexión. «Obras y autores» cuenta las lecturas por país o tradición de la colección.':'The map and paintings are included in the file and work offline. “Works & authors” counts readings by the collection’s country or tradition.'}</p><ul>${activePaintings().map(p=>`<li><a href="${esc(p.source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${esc(paintField(p,'title'))}</a> · ${esc(p.artist)} · ${esc(p.museum)} · ${esc(p.rights)}${p.attribution?`<br>${esc(p.attribution)}`:''}${p.rights_policy_url?` · <a href="${esc(p.rights_policy_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${lang==='es'?'Licencia':'Licence'} ↗</a>`:''}</li>`).join('')}</ul>`}

document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const region=e.target.closest('[data-region],[data-map-region]');if(region)selectRegion(region.dataset.region||region.dataset.mapRegion);const zoom=e.target.closest('[data-map-view]');if(zoom)setMapView(zoom.dataset.mapView);const art=e.target.closest('[data-art]');if(art&&Date.now()>=suppressArtClickUntil)openArt(art.dataset.art)});
$('#catalog-view').addEventListener('mouseover',e=>{const p=e.target.closest('[data-map-region]');if(p)$('#map-caption-text').innerHTML=mapCaption(p.dataset.mapRegion)});
$('#catalog-view').addEventListener('mouseout',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-map-region]'))$('#map-caption-text').innerHTML=mapCaption()});
$('#catalog-view').addEventListener('focusin',e=>{const p=e.target.closest('[data-map-region]');if(p)$('#map-caption-text').innerHTML=mapCaption(p.dataset.mapRegion)});
$('#catalog-view').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const p=e.target.closest('[data-map-region]');if(p&&['Enter',' '].includes(e.key)){e.preventDefault();selectRegion(p.dataset.mapRegion)}});
$('#catalog-open').onclick=()=>switchPage('catalog');

const packageName=p=>p[`title_${lang}`]||p.title_en;
const packageText=(p,key)=>p[`${key}_${lang}`]||p[`${key}_en`]||'';
const artCount=n=>`${n} ${lang==='es'?(n===1?'obra de arte':'obras de arte'):(n===1?'artwork':'artworks')}`;
function renderPackages(){
    const scroller=$('#packages-view'),scroll=scroller.scrollTop,opened=[...document.querySelectorAll('.package-details[open]')].map(d=>d.dataset.packageDetails);
    const baseWorks=works.filter(w=>w.package_id==='mvp'),baseArt=paintings.filter(p=>p.package_id==='mvp');
    const baseOpen=!!$('#base-readings')?.open;
    scroller.innerHTML=`<div class="packages-inner"><div class="packages-heading"><h2 id="packages-title" tabindex="-1">${lang==='es'?'Paquetes':'Packages'}</h2><p>${lang==='es'?'Elige qué quieres añadir a tu antología.':'Choose what to add to your anthology.'}</p></div><div class="package-selection" role="status"><strong>${readingCount(activeWorks().length)}</strong><span>·</span><strong>${artCount(activePaintings().length)}</strong><span class="package-selection-note">${lang==='es'?'en tu selección':'in your selection'}</span><button class="secondary" data-enable-all ${enabledPackages.size===packages.length?'disabled':''}>${lang==='es'?'Activar todos':'Enable all'}</button><button class="text-button" data-go-atlas>${lang==='es'?'Ver en el mapa →':'See on the map →'}</button></div><div class="base-package"><div class="base-package-heading"><div><h3>${lang==='es'?'La antología original':'The original anthology'} <span>MVP</span></h3><p>${readingCount(baseWorks.length)} · ${artCount(baseArt.length)}</p></div><span class="base-included">${lang==='es'?'Siempre incluida':'Always included'}</span></div><details class="base-readings" id="base-readings" ${baseOpen?'open':''}><summary>${lang==='es'?'Ver lecturas incluidas':'View included readings'}</summary><ul>${baseWorks.map(w=>`<li><button class="text-button" data-book="${esc(w.id)}">${esc(titleOf(w))}</button><span>${esc(w.author)}</span></li>`).join('')}</ul></details></div><div class="package-list">${packages.map(p=>{
        const on=enabledPackages.has(p.id),list=works.filter(w=>w.package_id===p.id),art=paintings.filter(a=>a.package_id===p.id),cover=art.find(a=>a.id===p.cover_id)||art[0];
        return `<article class="package-card${on?' enabled':''}" data-package-card="${esc(p.id)}"><div class="package-main">${cover?`<img class="package-cover" src="${cover.image}" alt="${esc(paintField(cover,'title'))} — ${esc(cover.artist)}" loading="lazy" decoding="async">`:''}<div class="package-copy"><h3>${esc(packageName(p))}</h3><p>${esc(packageText(p,'description'))}</p><div class="package-counts"><span>+ ${readingCount(list.length)}</span><span>+ ${artCount(art.length)}</span></div></div><button class="package-toggle" role="switch" data-package-toggle="${esc(p.id)}" aria-checked="${on}" aria-label="${esc(packageName(p))}"><span class="switch-track" aria-hidden="true"><span></span></span><span>${on?(lang==='es'?'Activo':'Active'):(lang==='es'?'Activar':'Enable')}</span></button></div><details class="package-details" data-package-details="${esc(p.id)}" ${opened.includes(p.id)?'open':''}><summary>${lang==='es'?'Ver contenido':'View contents'}</summary><div class="package-detail-body"><p class="package-editor-note">${esc(packageText(p,'note'))}</p><div class="package-reading-list">${list.map(w=>`<div><span class="package-type">${esc(kindOf(w))} · ${minutes(w)}</span><h4>${on?`<button class="text-button" data-book="${esc(w.id)}">${esc(titleOf(w))} ↗</button>`:esc(titleOf(w))}</h4><p>${esc(w.author)} · ${esc(languageOf(w))}</p><p>${esc(scopeOf(w))}</p></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="package-art-list">${art.map(a=>`<figure><a href="${esc(a.source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><img src="${a.image}" alt="${esc(paintField(a,'alt'))}" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></a><figcaption><strong>${esc(paintField(a,'title'))}</strong><span>${esc(a.artist)} · ${esc(a.year)}</span><a href="${esc(a.source_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${esc(a.museum)} ↗</a></figcaption></figure>`).join('')}</div></div></details></article>`
    }).join('')}</div>${renderJourneyCards()}<p class="packages-footnote">${lang==='es'?'Tu selección se guarda en este navegador. Al desactivar un paquete, sus lecturas y su arte salen de la antología y de los recuentos. Puedes volver a activarlo cuando quieras.':'Your selection is saved in this browser. Disabling a package removes its readings and art from the anthology and its counts. You can enable it again at any time.'}</p><p class="packages-footnote">${lang==='es'?'Originales de dominio público · Fuentes identificadas · Traducciones de lectura en español e inglés · Arte con imágenes de uso libre.':'Public-domain originals · Identified sources · English and Spanish working translations · Art with freely reusable images.'}</p></div>`;
    scroller.scrollTop=scroll;
}
function setPackageEnabled(id,enabled){
    if(!packages.some(p=>p.id===id)||enabledPackages.has(id)===enabled)return;
    saveBookPosition();if(enabled)enabledPackages.add(id);else enabledPackages.delete(id);
    refreshPackageSelection(id);
    const p=packages.find(p=>p.id===id);$('#announcement').textContent=`${packageName(p)}: ${enabled?(lang==='es'?'activado':'enabled'):(lang==='es'?'desactivado':'disabled')}. ${readingCount(activeWorks().length)}. ${artCount(activePaintings().length)}.`;
}
function setAllPackagesEnabled(){
    if(enabledPackages.size===packages.length)return;
    saveBookPosition();packages.forEach(p=>enabledPackages.add(p.id));refreshPackageSelection();
    $('#announcement').textContent=`${lang==='es'?'Todos los paquetes activados.':'All packages enabled.'} ${readingCount(activeWorks().length)}. ${artCount(activePaintings().length)}.`;
}
function refreshPackageSelection(id){
    try{localStorage.setItem('katabasis-packages-v1',JSON.stringify([...enabledPackages]))}catch{}
    // Indices refer to the immutable full corpus. Remove disabled cards from
    // history without redrawing works that still belong to the selection.
    const retained=history.map((entry,position)=>({entry,position})).filter(({entry})=>isEnabled(entry.type==='reading'?works[entry.index]:paintings[entry.index]));
    let preceding=retained.filter(h=>h.position<=historyPosition).length-1;
    history=retained.map(h=>h.entry);historyPosition=Math.max(0,preceding);
    if(!history.length){current=works.findIndex(w=>w.id==='long-happened');if(current<0)current=works.findIndex(isEnabled);history=[{type:'reading',index:current}];historyPosition=0;seen.add(current);readingsSincePainting=1}
    const lastRead=history.slice(0,historyPosition+1).filter(h=>h.type==='reading').at(-1);current=lastRead?lastRead.index:works.findIndex(isEnabled);
    if(active!==null&&!isEnabled(works[active]))closeDialog('book');
    if(artDetailIndex!==null&&!isEnabled(paintings[artDetailIndex])&&$('#art-dialog').open)closeDialog('art-dialog');
    if(selectedRegion!=='all'&&!regionCount(selectedRegion))selectedRegion='all';
    translateUI();renderReading();if($('#book').open)renderBook();if(page==='catalog')renderCatalog();if(page==='packages'){renderPackages();const toggle=document.querySelector(id?`[data-package-toggle="${id}"]`:'#packages-title');if(toggle)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true})}
    if(page==='favorites')renderFavorites();
}
$('#packages-open').onclick=()=>switchPage('packages');
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('[data-enable-all]'))setAllPackagesEnabled();const toggle=e.target.closest('[data-package-toggle]');if(toggle)setPackageEnabled(toggle.dataset.packageToggle,!enabledPackages.has(toggle.dataset.packageToggle));if(e.target.closest('[data-go-atlas]'))switchPage('catalog')});

// Routes are intentional book navigation, independent of random feed history.
function journeyFor(w){return journeys.find(j=>j.id===w.journey_id)}
function journeyText(item,key){return item[`${key}_${lang}`]||item[`${key}_en`]||''}
function journeyAvailable(step){return works.some(w=>w.id===step.reading_id&&isEnabled(w))}
function journeyFeedLink(w){
    const j=journeyFor(w);if(!j)return '';
    return ` · <button class="journey-feed-link" data-book="${esc(w.id)}">${esc(journeyText(j,'title'))} · ${w.journey_step+1}/${j.steps.length} ↗</button>`;
}
function journeyPanel(w){
    const j=journeyFor(w);if(!j)return '';
    const step=j.steps[w.journey_step];
    return `<section class="journey-panel" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'El hilo de la obra':'The story thread'}"><div class="journey-heading"><strong>${esc(journeyText(j,'title'))}</strong><span>${w.journey_step+1} / ${j.steps.length}</span></div><details class="journey-outline"><summary>${lang==='es'?'Ver los misterios':'See the mysteries'}</summary><p>${esc(journeyText(j,'intro'))}</p><ol>${j.steps.map((s,i)=>`<li>${journeyAvailable(s)?`<button class="text-button" data-book="${esc(s.reading_id)}" ${i===w.journey_step?'aria-current="step"':''}>${esc(journeyText(s,'label'))}</button>`:`<span>${esc(journeyText(s,'label'))}</span> <small>${lang==='es'?'· paquete inactivo':'· package disabled'}</small>`}</li>`).join('')}</ol>${enabledPackages.has(j.package_id)?'':`<button class="text-button" data-journey-package="${esc(j.package_id)}">${lang==='es'?'Ver el paquete para completar los misterios →':'View the package to complete the mysteries →'}</button>`}</details><p class="journey-editorial">${lang==='es'?'Puente narrativo · Katabasis':'Editorial bridge · Katabasis'}</p><p class="journey-bridge">${esc(journeyText(step,'bridge'))}</p></section>`;
}
function journeyEnd(w){
    const j=journeyFor(w);if(!j)return '';
    const position=w.journey_step,previous=j.steps[position-1],next=j.steps[position+1];
    const button=(step,label)=>step?(journeyAvailable(step)?`<button class="secondary" data-book="${esc(step.reading_id)}">${label}: ${esc(journeyText(step,'label'))}</button>`:`<button class="text-button" data-journey-package="${esc(j.package_id)}">${lang==='es'?'Ver el paquete para seguir →':'View the package to continue →'}</button>`):'';
    return `<div class="journey-end">${!next?`<p class="journey-editorial">${lang==='es'?'El desenlace · Síntesis de Katabasis':'The ending · A Katabasis summary'}</p><p>${esc(journeyText(j,'ending'))}</p>`:''}<nav class="journey-next" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Seguir los misterios':'Follow the mysteries'}">${button(previous,lang==='es'?'← Anterior':'← Previous')}${button(next,lang==='es'?'Siguiente →':'Next →')}</nav>${!next?`<p class="journey-finished">${lang==='es'?'Has llegado al final de estos misterios. Cada escena también puede leerse por separado.':'You have reached the end of these mysteries. Each scene can also be read on its own.'}</p>`:''}</div>`;
}
function renderJourneyCards(){
    return `<section class="journey-collection"><h3>${lang==='es'?'Misterios':'Mysteries'}</h3><p>${lang==='es'?'Escenas que se sostienen solas, unidas por el hilo de una historia. Los títulos literarios describen cada escena y son de Katabasis; los del Rosario siguen sus nombres tradicionales. Los puentes y desenlaces son síntesis de Katabasis; los pasajes literarios conservan su original y su traducción.':'Scenes that stand on their own, connected by a story’s thread. Literary scene titles are Katabasis descriptions; Rosary mysteries retain their traditional names. Bridges and endings are Katabasis summaries; literary passages retain their original and translation.'}</p><div class="journey-cards">${journeys.map(j=>`<article><span class="journey-editorial">${j.steps.length} ${lang==='es'?'misterios':'mysteries'}</span><h4>${esc(journeyText(j,'title'))}</h4><p>${esc(journeyText(j,'intro'))}</p>${enabledPackages.has(j.package_id)?`<button class="text-button" data-book="${esc(j.steps[0].reading_id)}">${lang==='es'?'Comenzar los misterios →':'Begin the mysteries →'}</button>`:`<button class="text-button" data-journey-package="${esc(j.package_id)}">${lang==='es'?'Ver el paquete →':'View the package →'}</button>`}</article>`).join('')}</div></section>`;
}
function appendEditorialPolicy(){
    const body=$('#about-body');
    body.innerHTML+=lang==='es'?'<h3>Lecturas con principio y final</h3><p>El límite es de diez minutos estimados, a 190 palabras por minuto; la mayoría de las lecturas queda muy por debajo. En los misterios se cuenta también el puente de la escena. El ritmo real de lectura puede variar. Los poemas breves se conservan completos. En obras extensas elegimos episodios con sentido propio y señalamos sus límites, sin cortar automáticamente al alcanzar una duración.</p><p>Los misterios literarios conectan escenas mediante puentes narrativos y un desenlace editorial, identificados como textos de Katabasis. No sustituyen la obra íntegra ni se atribuyen a su autor. Pueden revelar el argumento completo.</p>':'<h3>Readings with a beginning and an ending</h3><p>The ceiling is ten estimated minutes, at 190 words per minute; most readings are much shorter. Mystery timings also include the current scene’s bridge. Actual reading pace varies. Brief poems are kept complete. For long works we select coherent episodes and state their boundaries, without cutting automatically at a time limit.</p><p>Literary mysteries connect scenes through narrative bridges and an editorial ending, identified as Katabasis texts. They do not replace the complete work or claim its author’s words. They may reveal the whole plot.</p>';
}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    const target=e.target.closest('[data-journey-package]');if(!target)return;
    const id=target.dataset.journeyPackage;if(!packages.some(p=>p.id===id))return;
    if($('#book').open)closeDialog('book');
    switchPage('packages');
    const card=document.querySelector(`[data-package-card="${id}"]`);
    if(card){card.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});card.querySelector('[data-package-toggle]')?.focus({preventScroll:true})}
});

function favoriteKey(type,id){return type+':'+id}
function favoriteItem(type,id){return (type==='reading'?works:type==='painting'?paintings:[]).find(item=>item.id===id)}
function loadFavorites(){
    try{
        const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('katabasis-favorites-v1')||'[]');
        if(Array.isArray(saved))for(const entry of saved){
            if(entry&&favoriteItem(entry.type,entry.id))favorites.set(favoriteKey(entry.type,entry.id),{type:entry.type,id:entry.id});
        }
    }catch{}
}
function favoriteName(type,item){return type==='reading'?titleOf(item):paintField(item,'title')}
function favoriteButton(type,id){
    const item=favoriteItem(type,id);if(!item)return '';
    const saved=favorites.has(favoriteKey(type,id));
    return `<button class="favorite-button" data-favorite-type="${type}" data-favorite-id="${esc(id)}" aria-pressed="${saved}" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Guardar en favoritos':'Save to favourites'}: ${esc(favoriteName(type,item))}"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3h12v18l-6-4-6 4z"/></svg><span>${saved?(lang==='es'?'Guardado':'Saved'):(lang==='es'?'Guardar':'Save')}</span></button>`;
}
function refreshFavoriteButtons(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-favorite-id]').forEach(button=>{
        const saved=favorites.has(favoriteKey(button.dataset.favoriteType,button.dataset.favoriteId));
        button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(saved));
        const label=button.querySelector('span');if(label)label.textContent=saved?(lang==='es'?'Guardado':'Saved'):(lang==='es'?'Guardar':'Save');
    });
    $('#favorites-count').textContent=String(favorites.size);
    $('#favorites-count').hidden=favorites.size===0;
    $('#favorites-open').ariaLabel=`${lang==='es'?'Guardados':'Saved'}: ${favorites.size}`;
}
function toggleFavorite(type,id){
    const item=favoriteItem(type,id);if(!item)return;
    const key=favoriteKey(type,id),wasSaved=favorites.has(key),position=[...favorites.keys()].reverse().indexOf(key);
    if(wasSaved)favorites.delete(key);else favorites.set(key,{type,id});
    let persisted=true;
    try{localStorage.setItem('katabasis-favorites-v1',JSON.stringify([...favorites.values()]))}catch{persisted=false}
    refreshFavoriteButtons();
    if(page==='favorites'){
        renderFavorites();
        if(!document.querySelector('dialog[open]')){
            const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('#favorites-view [data-saved-open]')];
            (buttons[Math.max(0,Math.min(position,buttons.length-1))]||$('#favorites-title')).focus({preventScroll:true});
        }
    }
    $('#announcement').textContent=`${favoriteName(type,item)}. ${wasSaved?(lang==='es'?'Quitado de guardados.':'Removed from saved.'):(lang==='es'?'Guardado.':'Saved.')}${persisted?'':(lang==='es'?' El navegador no permite conservar el cambio al cerrar; está disponible en esta sesión.':' This browser cannot keep the change after closing; it is available for this session.')}`;
}
function renderFavorites(){
    const el=$('#favorites-view'),scroll=el.scrollTop,entries=[...favorites.values()].reverse();
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="favorites-inner"><div class="favorites-heading"><p class="tiny-title">${lang==='es'?'Para volver':'To return to'}</p><h2 id="favorites-title" tabindex="-1">${lang==='es'?'Guardados':'Saved'}</h2><p>${lang==='es'?'Las palabras y las imágenes que quieres conservar.':'Words and images you want to keep.'}</p></div>${entries.length?`<p class="favorites-total">${entries.length} ${lang==='es'?'guardados':'saved items'}</p><div class="favorites-list">${entries.map(entry=>{
        const {type,id}=entry,item=favoriteItem(type,id),enabled=isEnabled(item),p=packages.find(p=>p.id===item.package_id);
        const title=favoriteName(type,item),author=type==='reading'?item.author:paintField(item,'artist');
        return `<article class="saved-item">${type==='painting'?`<img class="saved-art" src="${item.image}" alt="${esc(paintField(item,'alt'))}" loading="lazy">`:''}<div class="saved-copy"><p class="saved-meta">${type==='reading'?`${esc(kindOf(item))} · ${minutes(item)}`:esc(paintField(item,'art_kind'))}</p><h3>${esc(title)}</h3><p>${esc(author)}</p>${!enabled?`<p class="saved-package">${esc(packageName(p))} · ${lang==='es'?'paquete desactivado':'package disabled'}</p>`:''}<button class="text-button saved-open" data-saved-open="${esc(id)}" data-saved-type="${type}">${!enabled?(lang==='es'?'Activar paquete y abrir':'Enable package and open'):type==='reading'?(lang==='es'?'Abrir el libro':'Open the book'):(lang==='es'?'Ver ilustración':'View artwork')} <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div>${favoriteButton(type,id)}</article>`;
    }).join('')}</div>`:`<div class="favorites-empty"><p>${lang==='es'?'Todavía no has guardado nada.':'Nothing saved yet.'}</p><p>${lang==='es'?'Pulsa «Guardar» en una lectura o ilustración y aparecerá aquí.':'Choose “Save” on a reading or artwork to find it here.'}</p><button class="book-btn" data-saved-discover>${lang==='es'?'Ir a la antología':'Go to the anthology'}</button></div>`}<p class="favorites-note">${lang==='es'?'Tus guardados se conservan en este navegador. Desactivar un paquete no los borra.':'Your saved items stay in this browser. Disabling a package does not delete them.'}</p></div>`;
    el.scrollTop=scroll;
}
function openFavorite(type,id){
    if(!favorites.has(favoriteKey(type,id)))return;
    const item=favoriteItem(type,id);if(!item)return;
    if(!isEnabled(item))setPackageEnabled(item.package_id,true);
    if(type==='reading')openBook(id);else openArt(id);
}
$('#favorites-open').onclick=()=>switchPage('favorites');
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    const save=e.target.closest('[data-favorite-id]');if(save)toggleFavorite(save.dataset.favoriteType,save.dataset.favoriteId);
    const open=e.target.closest('[data-saved-open]');if(open)openFavorite(open.dataset.savedType,open.dataset.savedOpen);
    if(e.target.closest('[data-saved-discover]'))switchPage('anthology');
});

// Writing workshop — local, account-free drafts.
const workshopForms={
  sonnet:{name_es:'Soneto',name_en:'Sonnet',lines:14,targets:[11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11,11],stanzas:[4,4,3,3],rhyme:'ABBA\nABBA\nCDC\nDCD',hint_es:'14 endecasílabos · dos cuartetos y dos tercetos',hint_en:'14 hendecasyllables · two quatrains and two tercets'},
  romance:{name_es:'Romance',name_en:'Romance',lines:16,targets:Array(16).fill(8),stanzas:[16],rhyme:'–A–A–A–A…',hint_es:'Octosílabos · asonancia en los versos pares',hint_en:'Octosyllables · assonance on even lines'},
  decima:{name_es:'Décima espinela',name_en:'Décima espinela',lines:10,targets:Array(10).fill(8),stanzas:[10],rhyme:'ABBAACCDDC',hint_es:'10 octosílabos · esquema ABBAACCDDC',hint_en:'10 octosyllables · ABBAACCDDC'},
  redondilla:{name_es:'Redondilla',name_en:'Redondilla',lines:4,targets:[8,8,8,8],stanzas:[4],rhyme:'ABBA',hint_es:'4 octosílabos · rima abrazada',hint_en:'4 octosyllables · enclosed rhyme'},
  lira:{name_es:'Lira',name_en:'Lira',lines:5,targets:[7,11,7,7,11],stanzas:[5],rhyme:'aBabB',hint_es:'7 / 11 / 7 / 7 / 11 · aBabB',hint_en:'7 / 11 / 7 / 7 / 11 · aBabB'},
  alejandrino:{name_es:'Alejandrinos',name_en:'Alexandrines',lines:8,targets:Array(8).fill(14),stanzas:[4,4],rhyme:'7 + 7',hint_es:'Versos de 14 sílabas con cesura 7 + 7',hint_en:'14-syllable lines with a 7 + 7 caesura'}
};
let workshopForm='sonnet';
const workshopAdjustments={};
function workshopDraftKey(id){return 'katabasis-workshop-draft-v1:'+id}
function loadWorkshopDraft(id){try{return localStorage.getItem(workshopDraftKey(id))||''}catch{return ''}}
function saveWorkshopDraft(id,text){try{localStorage.setItem(workshopDraftKey(id),text);return true}catch{return false}}
function vowel(ch){return /[aeiouáéíóúü]/i.test(ch)}
function cleanMetricWord(word){return word.toLowerCase().replace(/^[^a-záéíóúüñ]+|[^a-záéíóúüñy]+$/gi,'')}
function wordNuclei(word){
  const w=cleanMetricWord(word);if(!w)return [];
  const nuclei=[];let i=0;
  while(i<w.length){
    if(!vowel(w[i])){i++;continue}
    const start=i;let group=w[i];i++;
    while(i<w.length&&vowel(w[i])){group+=w[i];i++}
    const strong=c=>/[aáeéoó]/i.test(c),accentWeak=c=>/[íú]/i.test(c);
    let count=1;
    for(let j=1;j<group.length;j++){
      const a=group[j-1],b=group[j];
      if(accentWeak(a)||accentWeak(b)||(strong(a)&&strong(b)))count++;
    }
    for(let k=0;k<count;k++)nuclei.push(start);
  }
  return nuclei;
}
function wordSyllables(word){return Math.max(1,wordNuclei(word).length)}
function finalStressAdjustment(word){
  const w=cleanMetricWord(word);if(!w)return {adjust:0,label:''};
  const nuclei=wordNuclei(w),n=nuclei.length;if(!n)return {adjust:0,label:''};
  const accents=[...w.matchAll(/[áéíóú]/gi)];let stressed;
  if(accents.length){const pos=accents.at(-1).index;stressed=nuclei.filter(x=>x<=pos).length-1}
  else stressed=/[aeiouáéíóúüns]$/i.test(w)?Math.max(0,n-2):n-1;
  const fromEnd=n-1-stressed;
  if(fromEnd===0)return {adjust:1,label:'aguda +1'};
  if(fromEnd>=2)return {adjust:-1,label:'esdrújula −1'};
  return {adjust:0,label:''};
}
function metricCount(line,index){
  const words=line.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);if(!words.length)return {count:0,base:0,sinalefas:0,final:'',manual:workshopAdjustments[index]||0};
  let base=words.reduce((sum,w)=>sum+wordSyllables(w),0),sinalefas=0;
  for(let i=0;i<words.length-1;i++){
    const a=cleanMetricWord(words[i]),b=cleanMetricWord(words[i+1]);
    if(!a||!b)continue;
    if(/[aeiouáéíóúüy]$/i.test(a)&&/^(?:h)?[aeiouáéíóúü]/i.test(b)){sinalefas++;base--}
  }
  const stress=finalStressAdjustment(words.at(-1));base+=stress.adjust;
  const manual=workshopAdjustments[index]||0;
  return {count:Math.max(0,base+manual),base:Math.max(0,base),sinalefas,final:stress.label,manual};
}
function formName(f){return lang==='es'?f.name_es:f.name_en}
function formHint(f){return lang==='es'?f.hint_es:f.hint_en}
function renderWorkshop(){
  const el=$('#workshop-view');if(!el)return;
  const form=workshopForms[workshopForm],draft=loadWorkshopDraft(workshopForm);
  el.innerHTML=`<div class="workshop-inner"><div class="workshop-heading"><div><p class="tiny-title">${lang==='es'?'Escribir para aprender':'Write to learn'}</p><h2 id="workshop-title" tabindex="-1">${lang==='es'?'Taller':'Workshop'}</h2><p>${lang==='es'?'Prácticas breves para escribir dentro de formas literarias, mirar de cerca sus restricciones y aprender usándolas.':'Short practices for writing inside literary forms, examining their constraints and learning by using them.'}</p></div><p class="workshop-local">${lang==='es'?'Tus borradores se guardan solo en este navegador. No se suben a Katabasis ni se comparten con otros lectores.':'Your drafts are stored only in this browser. They are not uploaded to Katabasis or shared with other readers.'}</p></div>
  <div class="practice-grid" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Prácticas':'Practices'}">
    <button class="practice-card active" aria-current="true"><strong>${lang==='es'?'Métrica':'Meter'}</strong><span>${lang==='es'?'Escribe sobre el molde de una forma poética.':'Write over the scaffold of a poetic form.'}</span></button>
    <button class="practice-card" disabled><strong>${lang==='es'?'Imitación':'Imitation'}</strong><span>${lang==='es'?'Próximamente · escribir desde un texto de la antología.':'Coming soon · write from an anthology text.'}</span></button>
    <button class="practice-card" disabled><strong>${lang==='es'?'Écfrasis':'Ekphrasis'}</strong><span>${lang==='es'?'Próximamente · escribir desde una obra de arte.':'Coming soon · write from an artwork.'}</span></button>
    <button class="practice-card" disabled><strong>${lang==='es'?'Restricción':'Constraint'}</strong><span>${lang==='es'?'Próximamente · escribir bajo una regla deliberada.':'Coming soon · write under a deliberate rule.'}</span></button>
    <button class="practice-card" disabled><strong>${lang==='es'?'Reescritura':'Rewriting'}</strong><span>${lang==='es'?'Próximamente · transformar una misma idea.':'Coming soon · transform the same idea.'}</span></button>
  </div>
  <div class="meter-workspace"><section class="meter-panel" aria-labelledby="meter-editor-title"><h3 id="meter-editor-title">${lang==='es'?'Métrica':'Meter'}</h3><p>${lang==='es'?'El contador es una guía: reconoce sinalefas comunes y el ajuste por palabra final, pero la métrica española admite decisiones de lectura. Usa ±1 cuando quieras imponer otra lectura.':'The counter is a guide: it recognizes common synaloepha and line-final stress, but Spanish meter allows interpretive choices. Use ±1 when you want another reading.'}</p>
  <div class="form-picker">${Object.entries(workshopForms).map(([id,f])=>`<button data-workshop-form="${id}" aria-pressed="${id===workshopForm}"><strong>${esc(formName(f))}</strong><br><small>${esc(formHint(f))}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>
  <textarea id="workshop-textarea" class="workshop-textarea" spellcheck="true" autocapitalize="sentences" placeholder="${lang==='es'?'Escribe aquí. Cada salto de línea es un verso.':'Write here. Each line break is a verse.'}">${esc(draft)}</textarea>
  <div class="draft-status"><span id="workshop-save-status">${lang==='es'?'Borrador local':'Local draft'}</span><span>${lang==='es'?'Sin cuenta · solo este dispositivo':'No account · this device only'}</span></div></section>
  <section class="poem-sheet" aria-label="${lang==='es'?'Molde métrico':'Metric scaffold'}"><div class="poem-sheet-head"><div><p class="tiny-title">${lang==='es'?'Molde':'Scaffold'}</p><h3>${esc(formName(form))}</h3><p>${esc(formHint(form))}</p></div><div class="rhyme-key">${esc(form.rhyme)}</div></div><div id="meter-preview"></div><p class="workshop-note">${lang==='es'?'Los puntos representan posiciones silábicas, no caracteres. Una línea puede ocupar exactamente el molde aunque tenga muchas más letras. En alejandrinos, la cesura se representa como 7 + 7; el cálculo automático no sustituye una lectura métrica consciente.':'Dots represent syllabic positions, not characters. A line can fit the scaffold exactly while containing many more letters. In alexandrines the caesura is shown as 7 + 7; automatic counting does not replace conscious metrical reading.'}</p></section></div></div>`;
  updateMeterPreview();
}
function updateMeterPreview(){
  const form=workshopForms[workshopForm],ta=$('#workshop-textarea'),preview=$('#meter-preview');if(!form||!ta||!preview)return;
  const lines=ta.value.replace(/\r/g,'').split('\n'),rows=[];let cursor=0;
  for(const stanzaSize of form.stanzas){
    const stanza=[];
    for(let j=0;j<stanzaSize;j++,cursor++){
      const text=lines[cursor]||'',target=form.targets[cursor],m=metricCount(text,cursor),shown=Math.max(target,m.count),slots=Array.from({length:shown},(_,i)=>`<span class="meter-slot ${i<m.count?(i<target?'filled':'overflow'):''}"></span>`).join('');
      const cls=m.count===target&&text.trim()?'good':m.count>target?'over':'';
      const details=[];if(m.sinalefas)details.push(`${m.sinalefas} ${m.sinalefas===1?'sinalefa':'sinalefas'}`);if(m.final)details.push(m.final);if(m.manual)details.push(`${lang==='es'?'ajuste':'adjustment'} ${m.manual>0?'+':''}${m.manual}`);
      const display=text.trim()?esc(text):`<span class="meter-line-text empty">${lang==='es'?'verso '+(cursor+1):'line '+(cursor+1)}</span>`;
      stanza.push(`<div class="meter-row"><div class="meter-number">${cursor+1}</div><div class="meter-line"><div class="meter-line-text">${display}</div><div class="meter-slots" aria-label="${m.count} / ${target}">${slots}</div><div class="meter-detail">${details.join(' · ')||'&nbsp;'}${text.trim()?`<span class="meter-adjust"><button data-meter-adjust="${cursor}" data-delta="-1" title="-1">−1</button><button data-meter-adjust="${cursor}" data-delta="1" title="+1">+1</button><button data-meter-reset="${cursor}" title="${lang==='es'?'Restablecer':'Reset'}">↺</button></span>`:''}</div></div><div class="meter-count ${cls}">${m.count} / ${target}</div></div>`);
    }
    rows.push(`<div class="meter-stanza">${stanza.join('')}</div>`);
  }
  if(lines.length>form.lines&&lines.slice(form.lines).some(x=>x.trim()))rows.push(`<div class="meter-stanza"><p class="meter-detail">${lang==='es'?`Hay ${lines.length-form.lines} verso(s) fuera del molde.`:`${lines.length-form.lines} line(s) extend beyond the scaffold.`}</p></div>`);
  preview.innerHTML=rows.join('');
}
function setWorkshopForm(id){
  if(!workshopForms[id]||id===workshopForm)return;
  const ta=$('#workshop-textarea');if(ta)saveWorkshopDraft(workshopForm,ta.value);
  workshopForm=id;for(const k of Object.keys(workshopAdjustments))delete workshopAdjustments[k];renderWorkshop();$('#workshop-textarea')?.focus();
}
$('#workshop-open').onclick=()=>switchPage('workshop');
document.addEventListener('input',e=>{
  if(e.target.id!=='workshop-textarea')return;
  const ok=saveWorkshopDraft(workshopForm,e.target.value);updateMeterPreview();
  const s=$('#workshop-save-status');if(s)s.textContent=ok?(lang==='es'?'Guardado en este navegador':'Saved in this browser'):(lang==='es'?'No se pudo guardar':'Could not save');
});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const form=e.target.closest('[data-workshop-form]');if(form)setWorkshopForm(form.dataset.workshopForm);
  const adjust=e.target.closest('[data-meter-adjust]');if(adjust){const i=Number(adjust.dataset.meterAdjust),delta=Number(adjust.dataset.delta);workshopAdjustments[i]=(workshopAdjustments[i]||0)+delta;updateMeterPreview()}
  const reset=e.target.closest('[data-meter-reset]');if(reset){delete workshopAdjustments[Number(reset.dataset.meterReset)];updateMeterPreview()}
});

document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.id==='learn-text'){try{localStorage.setItem('katabasis-learn-free-v1',e.target.value);$('#learn-save').textContent=__lt('Guardado en este navegador','Saved in this browser')}catch{}__meter()}});
document.addEventListener('scroll',e=>{if(e.target.id==='learn-text')__sync()},true);translateUI();

</script>
</body></html>
